annotations.title: Where the anime ends in the manga

description: Where the anime of a manga series ends in the manga: the chapters each TV season or film adapts, the chapter and Japanese volume to read on from, and the English edition of that volume with its date. Only ranges an editor checked. Takes a slug such as "oshi-no-ko" or a title.

series.description: The slug from a Mangainfo address (mangainfo.com/series/oshi-no-ko is oshi-no-ko) or a title.
